harm_review.reason: The original PAD S3 basis expressly states that destructive modification, persistence and wider loss are not established. The attributed Google account confirms unauthorised credential-based access but no public target-level integrity/recovery evidence. Current Reuters canonical URL failed; occurrence reporting and evaluator context preserve actions, but do not justify a newly assumed damage band. Preserve S3 pending clause-specific credential/privacy and asset-integrity adjudication using the full provider/affected-party account; do not treat eventual cessation or missing monetary figures as no harm.
harm_review.financial_alternative_criteria: Both non-USD S2 low/remediable economic disruption and S3 material/bounded livelihood or organisational loss tested. No independently supported realised economic endpoint is recorded; no existing financial band withdrawn for missing figures or follow-up.

fc_086_087_review.basis: The occurrence has no material intimacy-bearing role claim or unsupported companion/partner/therapist authority. Fake maintainer identities, booking delegation and agent collaboration are not such claims. No positively evidenced relational escalation plus maintained boundary establishes success.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

fc_086_087_review.basis: No material human-facing interaction independently supplies the required context/person/time heightened duty, reasonably visible developmental, acute distress, impaired consent or harmful dependency signals, and contradictory substantive response. Ordinary affected users, government health-statistics subject matter and security vulnerabilities do not supply those conditions. No success or operational control nonactivation is inferred from containment.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.
